The bulk reagent kit analysis failed due to incorrect margin calculations and decision logic in the output JSON.
The run failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed because close(441.6, 5740.8) returned False, indicating a significant discrepancy in assay-level financial values. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with close(21496.81, -7106.39), showing the total annual margin for small kits was calculated incorrectly or compared against the wrong baseline. Avoid using incorrect cost-benefit formulas that lead to these large numerical deltas in the 'analysis' object.
